20260918070321_add_shift: Drops the three old per-day unique indexes to replace them with per-shift ones. Index-only, no rows touched. Shipped before this guard existed; statements read, not re-tested.
20260926081920_drop_receipts: Drops the receipts and receipt_items tables (feature removed). Deletes that data by design. Shipped before this guard existed; statements read, not re-tested.
20260930120000_drop_delivery_destination: Drops delivery_destinations and offline_entry_deliveries (feature removed). Deletes that data by design. Shipped before this guard existed; statements read, not re-tested.
20260930140000_add_delivery_slots: Backfills delivery1 from deliveryOut so existing rows keep their figure. Shipped before this guard existed; statements read, not re-tested.
20261009150000_add_manual_count_publish: Backfills publishedAt from updatedAt so existing counts stay published. Shipped before this guard existed; statements read, not re-tested.
20261015090000_per_page_day_lock: Copies isClosed into the new onlineLocked/offlineLocked columns so closed days stay closed. Shipped before this guard existed; statements read, not re-tested.
20261016140000_uppercase_product_names: Rewrites every products.name to UPPER(TRIM(name)). Lossy: original casing is not recoverable except from a backup. Shipped before this guard existed; statements read, not re-tested.
20261024090000_flip_variance_sign: Negates every non-zero manual_counts.variance (variance is now manual - system). Applying it twice would flip the signs back; Prisma applies it once per database. Shipped in v2.4.1; statements read, not re-tested on real data.
20261030120000_force_password_change: Sets users.mustChangePassword = true for every existing account, so each person chooses their own password at next sign-in (and the new 10-character rules apply). Reversible by setting the column back to false; no passwords are changed.
20261031090000_single_encoder_role: Merges the ONLINE_ENCODER and OFFLINE_ENCODER roles into one ENCODER: widens users.role to include ENCODER, UPDATEs every encoder row to it, then narrows the enum to ENCODER and SUPERVISOR_ADMIN. Touches only users.role; no passwords, MFA or other tables change. Lossy in one way: nothing records who was Online or Offline afterwards, so undoing it means restoring the pre-deploy snapshot (deploy.sh takes one first). Checked on the dev database: the two old encoder accounts came back as ENCODER with the same usernames and password hashes and the row count unchanged; CI applies it to an empty database. Not run on a restored copy of production data.
